title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE History Paper 1 (Structured Questions)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 Paper 1: Section A on the Core content (answer two) and Section B on the depth studies (answer one), 2 hours, 60 marks. Answer the Section A questions on the option you studied (A: the nineteenth century, or B: the twentieth century). This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **two** questions from Section A and **one** question from Section B. You have 2 hours.

- Each question is worth 20 marks: (a) 4, (b) 6 and (c) 10.
- In part (c) explain both sides and reach a supported judgement.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 of the 2027-2028 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE History Paper 2 (Document Questions)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 Paper 2: one 40-mark question on a prescribed topic with several sources, 1 hour 45 minutes. The sources are written for this platform; they are not real historical documents. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** parts of the question. You have 1 hour 45 minutes.

- Use the sources and your own knowledge; explain how far you trust each source.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 of the 2027-2028 syllabus; the prescribed topic changes each series, so this paper may be on a different topic from yours. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE History Paper 4 (Alternative to Coursework)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 Paper 4: one 40-mark question on a depth study, chosen from one per depth study, 1 hour. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **one** question, on the depth study you studied. You have 1 hour.

- Part (a) asks for an account; part (b) asks how important a person, organisation, development or event was.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 4 of the 2027-2028 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
